name: Seekh Kabab
description: Juicy Pakistani beef seekh kababs seasoned with herbs and spices, shaped around skewers and grilled until browned and fully cooked.
ingredients: 750 g beef mince with some fat
1 small onion, very finely chopped and excess moisture squeezed out
method: Combine the beef mince, squeezed onion, green chilies, coriander, ginger-garlic paste, seekh kabab masala, lemon juice and salt.
Mix and knead the mince for several minutes until it becomes sticky enough to hold together. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes.
With damp or lightly oiled hands, press the mixture evenly around skewers, keeping each kabab a consistent thickness.
Grill or barbecue over medium-high heat, turning carefully and brushing lightly with oil as needed.
Cook until browned on all sides and fully cooked in the centre; ground beef should reach 71°C/160°F.
Rest briefly, then slide from the skewers and serve hot with chutney, onion and lemon.
tips: Squeeze excess moisture from the onion so the kababs hold to the skewers.
Do not make the kababs too thick or the outside may brown before the centre cooks.
storage: Refrigerate cooked kababs promptly in a covered container for up to 2 days and reheat until piping hot.
